title: Maru Doctor
summary: Behavioral contract for the read-only `maru doctor` command and the related skills dirty/update/sync/reconcile commands, including issue codes and exit codes.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity. No adr/prd/spec path or filename convention, no frontmatter, and prose-heavy sections read like reference documentation (DOC signal). Chose SPEC because the dominant content is machine-facing contract: an issue-code table with severity levels, explicit exit-code semantics (--quiet exits 0/1, sync --check exits 1), read-only guarantees (never writes registry.json, never repairs links), and refusal rules (bundled --accept refused, non-symlink tool content not overwritten). Per the ambiguity rule the higher-precedence signal (SPEC) wins. cross_refs empty: the document mentions filesystem paths (registry.json, SKILL.md, ~/.maru/skills/_bundles/<id>/) but contains no links or references to other documents.
